correctness.rationale: The complete multipartite Laplacian has orthogonal projectors onto constants (eigenvalue 0), part-constant zero-sum modes (n), and within-part zero-sum modes (n-a_i). Hence between-part entries equal (1-F(nh))/n, within-part distinct entries equal (n-a_i)h/a_i[g((n-a_i)h)-g(nh)], and diagonals are nonnegative convex combinations when 0<=F<=1. K2 enforces F<=1; large complete stars/complete graphs and boundedness enforce F>=0; dense rational part-size ratios enforce nonincreasing g=(1-F)/x. The [2/2] Gauss filter F=(x^2-6x+12)/(x^2+6x+12) has strictly positive numerator and strictly decreasing g=12/(x^2+6x+12), so all positive steps on this graph class have positive stochastic entries. Independent exact rational matrix algebra verifies the P4 h=20 negative entry -643260/32303047 outside the class.

Its spectral projector entry formulas and converse are the same proof. The submitted path P4 negative illustration cannot restore originality of the covered main theorem.
residual_risks: Full primary literature on general Padé positivity was not exhaustively inspected, but direct earlier identical Resultary theorem decisively covers the submitted main claim.
